messages:
Alex: FYI we're targeting the Nova region smoke on Tue 10:00 PT. Need final owner roster and any infra/KMS/firewall blockers by EOD Mon. Plan is smoke -> small canary -> wide. Thinking to turn off geo-cache prefill for the smoke to keep writes quiet. Thoughts?

Maria: I can own routing cutover and basic SLA checks for the run. KMS key still pending from infra side. If KMS not ready we toggle customer-managed key off for the smoke.

Devon: KMS terraform PR is up: https://git.internal/r/redwood/kms/merge_requests/482. Sets alias/name to `alias/nova-infer`. ETA EOD Mon for approval. Maria, confirm alias name please.

Jia: Staging LB needs updated healthcheck path and firewall rules. I opened infra#210 but it needs one more review to add the cloud-Nova ranges. Also the LB needs the /healthz path configured (current is /status).

Sam: Posted firewall ranges: 34.210.192.0/22, 35.201.64.0/18. Recommend adding the staging canary token to the smoke run and enabling the low-capacity fallback model variant in canary.

Alex: Ok blockers summary so far: 1) KMS alias, 2) LB healthcheck path + firewall, 3) staging canary token, 4) ML quantization profile. I'll proceed with disabling geo-cache prefill for smoke unless someone objects.

Maria: Fine to disable prefill. One more blocker for me: audit logs retention toggle needs security ack for test-only short retention. @Devon @Alex can you ping security?

Devon: @security please ACK temporary audit retention short-window for Nova smoke. It's test-only - we won't retain long-term.

Priya: ML note: quant profile for Nova is in review (model-ops#77). If we can't finalize quant before smoke, set fallback variant to fp16 to avoid errors.

Sam: QA checklist proposal before Tue: - deploy manifests use stable images - LB healthcheck set to /healthz - firewall ranges applied - canary token present - fallback model configured - smoke command: `./scripts/smoke --region nova --staging --no-prefill`

Maria: Owners list to confirm: routing/cutover = Maria; kms/key = Devon; infra/LB+fw = Jia + Sam; ml/quant = Priya; security/audit = security.

Alex: I'll post a short pre-smoke checklist in #eng-oncall 45 minutes before start and ping owners. If PRs reviewed by EOD Mon we'll keep schedule. :rocket:
